# Generation 5 — Gevurah Critique

The Awtsmoos gives every expanding light a vessel fit to hold;
Awtsmoos.com must improve without invented facts, unsafe writes, or architecture grown cold.

## Critique and selection

- Do not implement fake hreflang because current translations do not expose trustworthy paired standalone language identities.
- Do not fabricate publication dates, ratings, prices, platforms, or translation titles.
- Do not add hidden H1 text merely to satisfy an audit metric.
- Do not broaden ProfilePage data beyond already-public alias fields.
- Do not index auth/API/action/admin/edit/control routes.
- Do not weaken crawler failure semantics to hide redirects, 404s, or server errors.
- Do not recursively crawl without hard concurrency, URL, sitemap, and timeout limits.
- Do not transplant remote-overlap files when the tested change did not require them.
- Do not force the dirty canonical checkout onto latest remote while unrelated agents own overlapping dirty files.
- Do not edit generated artifacts or release manifests by hand.
- Prefer fixes that remove real discovery ambiguity and improve users and crawlers simultaneously.

## Highest-value immediate work

1. Finish `/heichelos/` semantic head at its local renderer boundary.
2. Add renderer regression covering canonical, robots, title, description, and CollectionPage JSON-LD.
3. Restart a fresh process and rerun targeted + full crawl.
4. Improve crawler report with latency percentiles only if the full graph remains stable and this does not delay deployment.
5. Transplant exact tested SEO files to the clean current-origin worktree.
6. Verify byte identity and generated-artifact determinism.
7. Run all focused, Heichel, route, and tunnel-release gates in clean worktree.
8. Fresh-worktree runtime proof.
9. Race-check origin/main; rebase/recreate only if required.
10. Commit, push, exact-SHA activate, raw-public verify, browser-shadow verify.
